verdict.rationale: Codex Plugins documents a portable Agent Plugins manifest (`plugin.json` declaring the Agent Plugins schema) and says skills build on the open agent skills standard. A hands-on probe shows the catalog's skills are plain portable folders that third-party tooling can install, so the format itself is not locked to Codex. However, the evidence shows no first-party flow for installing a collection into Claude Code, Cursor or other harnesses, and no per-harness install instructions. The Claude Code migration guidance covers moving plugins into OpenAI, not out to other agents. missing for 10: documented install paths for Claude Code/Cursor/other agents, per-harness instructions, first-party cross-agent installer, independent corroboration of the same collection working across harnesses.
